command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "foreach(`$p in @('CampusNetwork_02','CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_05','CampusNetwork_06','CampusNetwork_07','CampusNetwork_08','CampusNetwork_09')){ foreach(`$n in @('Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02')){ `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString('display current-configuration'); try{ `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u).output; `$m=(`$o -split '\r?\n') | Where-Object {`$_ -match '^ vrrp vrid [1-4] priority' }; Write-Output (`$p+' '+`$n+': '+(`$m -join ', ')) } catch { Write-Output (`$p+' '+`$n+': unavailable') } } }"
